description.zh:
互通区域ID。

> 如果您不输入本参数，系统默认会帮您查询云企业网支持的所有互通区域信息。
description.en:
The ID of the areas that are connected by the CEN instance.

> If you do not set this parameter, the system queries the information about all areas supported by CEN.
The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为**10**，取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
